about: [C13] after the critic: IV's box of rounds and the dry gun's tells. At the corridor's checkpoint: the box on the secretary's desk, 'take the rounds', E adds 12 to the pocket and it is gone; a fall there gives back the checkpoint's counts and the box as it was (no floor); a checkpoint reached short with the box taken finds it on the desk again (the guard). Then subtitles off: the empty pocket's row of hollows and 'Empty.' still shown. NOIR_PORT=5353 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/c13_box.json

steps.name: the counts the corridor begins with, from CHAPTERS (the chapter's row), and the box on the desk

steps.label: the box on the secretary's desk: E take the rounds
E: twelve into the pocket, the box gone

steps.name: a fall here: the checkpoint's counts and the box as they were (no floor, no top-up)

steps.expect: G.player.weapons.impls.revolver.ammo + G.player.weapons.impls.revolver.pocket === window.__c0[0] + window.__c0[1] && G.save.flags.ivBox.taken === false
steps.label: the retry: the counts as reached, the box back on the desk as it was then

steps.name: the guard: a checkpoint reached short with the box taken - the box on the desk again, nothing in the pocket by itself

steps.label: short: the 7 reached (6 + 1), the box on the desk to fetch

steps.name: subtitles off, the pocket and the cylinder empty: the hollow row and Empty. shown
